entity: Chronic-violator wastewater permits with no formal enforcement, concentrated in Missouri and Ohio
what_we_add: 433 national chronic permits, Missouri 97 and Ohio 68, half of each state's chronic violators vs 18% elsewhere
why: EPA's Missouri SRF states the exact finding in words: repeat violators cycled through informal letters, never referred to formal enforcement; the Ohio SRF shows the same 4+-quarter SNC problem. No source has our counts.
